subject.title: Google Chat: replyToMode: "off" does not suppress thread replies

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 the canonical landing path for this Google Chat `replyToMode: "off"` bug, or switch to the broader overlapping thread-preservation work?
rationale: The issue has a clear source-level bug and an open closing PR, but choosing the canonical thread-routing fix path is a human review decision, not a new ClawSweeper repair job.

options.title: Review and land PR 89790
options.body: Use the focused closing PR as the canonical fix once maintainers are satisfied with exact-head proof or a proof override.

options.title: Switch to broader thread work
options.body: If maintainers prefer the broader thread-preservation branch, make that PR canonical and close or retarget the focused replacement after the broader path is viable.

options.title: Reject the behavior change
options.body: If maintainers no longer want `replyToMode: "off"` to suppress Google Chat thread replies, close the issue and associated fix PRs with the new product rationale.

recommendation.title: Review and land PR 89790
recommendation.body: Use the focused closing PR as the canonical fix once maintainers are satisfied with exact-head proof or a proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate from the history: landed the original Google Chat thread option support and has recent related delivery refactors.
